notes.title: Pawn Planet 0.62 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this patch includes some fixes and changes;


Improved game loading time.
You can now drop the vending machine box and take it back.
Some repair machine and vending machine fixes.
Added a notification when trying to pick up boxes while the shop is open.
Inverse mouse fixed to only work on the Y-axis.
Gamble money now saves correctly.
Heist enemy AI improvements.
The cleaning robot no longer collides with customers.
Fixed shop floor hex design. The color red now shows up correctly instead of purple.
Fixed being able to use wall paints before purchasing them.
Fixed an issue where music sometimes stops.
Other minor fixes.


Please let us know if you encounter any bug.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Shop Customization Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Shop Update is here!

Thank you all for your patience and support. We hope you enjoy this update.

Features
New Shop Design
We've decided to focus more on shop customization, as it was limited, and we cannot build upon it. As a result, we've redesigned the shop to make it more customizable. You can now expand the shop multiple times and change wall colors as well as purchase additional shelves. These changes will also allow us to add more machines to the backroom in the future and improve the late game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/e35de3b8675fd762d917fb526e67fc807919704d.png
You can also upgrade the shop even further now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/d44013dd7eb725315e2c76a7cf27539d62380782.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/1b4962a0fefcac0389b16dcc0eb0beff8d59e074.png

Customization
You can now purchase different wall, door colors and floor textures!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/a8f10f8c50ee71cf097bb87daa31ecaa6cd2b605.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/5cd0fe98437c71d6e80e0b94a0ba17fcbaa8d49e.png

Additional Shelves
You can now purchase new shelves and place them however you like!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/45397b301606a9810ebcfa95d50d08923eeace11.gif

Home
Who doesn't love it's own home? Now you can purchase your own house and decorate it! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/b8c90ae6d72fccc3dfcc5a90655355c6b700ccc8.png


General Improvements

Added 7 new items.
Added new customer models.
Added inverse mouse settings.
Instead of quitting you can now return to the menu.
Added typing numbers to the casino bets.
Graphic quality options.
Added trash bin to the auction planets

Bug fixes

Fixed thief sometimes drops an unpickable item.
Fixed unable to withdraw stackable items from storage when inventory is full.
Fixed some bugs related to the repair machine.


Since this update changes some in-game stuff, please let us know if you encounter a bug. We hope you enjoy this update. 
Thank you!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a month since we've released Pawn Planet and we would like to thank everyone who has played our game!

Firstly, here are some cool pictures of what we're working on;

New items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/befa97303f4aad72eae8963845354c59226ac823.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/6d7afc2de9cb0ff7889a0d1b5a69910b2f82c4fd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/ef6ce15bd8cf8ffe411a9316cafe363d8f48318e.png

New customer model.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/05cc6740226571c5d98f45b0a53b3f20f11dc484.jpg
New spaceships cosmetics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/39555e3d9089636cdd6f8a4450e14680b5e0dffb.jpg

Home Sweet Home
We're also adding a house! Now you can purchase a house and add decorations in it. When you purchase a house, you'll gain extra item storage and be able to sleep in it. Pets will also be able to live inside the house.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/b8c90ae6d72fccc3dfcc5a90655355c6b700ccc8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/a3477735eb0f9aa7c979f341fbc8227f24d2fc99.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/f0e4457b4dcc3891135cd2c45c47d2df928cfa96.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/d53d718d4e9ed3c05d84cad3bc3eef437ceb8c6a.jpg

Pets!?
You can now adopt pets! Just make sure you feed them. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/b22d5250e4def7c4bb286a3ef20d01956900f21e.jpg
We're still working on the pets and will publish more updates.

Moving shelves.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/eab56b3358222278df28ad9f4662af2a9fd17bbf.gif
We've implemented a way to change the position and rotation of shelves. Now you can place it however you like.

Changes
We have also fixed reported bugs and improved a lot of gameplay elements which will be available in the upcoming update with a full list.

That's all for our second Devlog. Feel free to let us know if you encounter any bugs or have a feedback. 

Thank you!

notes.title: Pawn Planet Early Access is Here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone

Pawn Planet is available right now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/6191c1dcb4e087087a72a45e265f293c7fb14ee5.jpg

We received a lot of support and feedbacks during Next Fest and from our free game Pawn Planet First Sales. So thank you to everyone! Since this is a Early Access game, there could be some bugs player may encounter. Please do report them to us and will fix it asap.

Here's the new features and changes;

Changes & Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/0b1351f2555e104e1e6bb8bb42091416c5a089e3.jpg
New customer ships.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/043a8d6200bffe2c49a55540c9b360ddd02b0618.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/4f77eaea05df2d21ff575aa4cfc0b217809f4027.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/3de39e5117b289469350cb567fd0699f54b3469b.png
Gamble Planet. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/0e10588a65b7123d403993e8e91c9b4f60ae36c3.gif
Vending Machine for customers.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/a25efae52d2f63dd159052e5e6acc37b523d6651.gif
Get scrap from items.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/3049a64be3cab55e19ccfdd6007cc79cd9aa2372.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/19bffa1706ee713b27f2fbcbc75b9f7042068dd4.png
New Decorations

More changes

Unlocked all the planets for auction.
More SFXs.
Player spaceship graphical improvements.
Many small improvements.
Lots of bug fixes.


Roadmap
We would like to expand our game with more features and here is our current plan;

Item Codex
This Codex will include all game items in locked state until player purchases. It will show price info, description and scrap of the item. 

Story Intro
We want to include a short story to the start of the game. This will explain why player starting a job in the Pawn Planet.

More Items and Customers
We are already working on some new customers and items. Wackier than ever.

New Mini Games
Just like bug race and blackjack, we are thinking different games to the area and will add them in the upcoming updates.

That's it for our plans right now, if you have more ideas feel free to join our discord and talk to us;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/c2f711c01f9b5d5c7acba303fc3ff5194c3ab456.png

I hope you enjoy our game, thank you everyone!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We had a great Summer Next Fest! More than 30,000 people downloaded our game and got 10,000+ wishlistes so thank you to all! 🎉 

As we get closer to the release, here are some updates we're working on;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/b4120951d86c40d04c5d90dbb153068f9156d3a8.png

Placement

Thieves

SFX

Sleep sounds

That's all for the first Devlog, in the meantime; 

Feel free to join our discord and say hello.

notes.title: Upcoming Features 👽
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to release our game at this Summer Next Fest! 🎉 
While you're enjoying the demo (hopefully 🤞), here are some updates we're working on;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/6a98e409a9be2ceecdbb25a2fc5ca41d9c7493a8.png
